grouped_layout.verification: All grouped argument sequences, scatter destinations and 32-bit operation-count bounds match RU decode; excludes memw output placeholders by upstream convention

liveness.method: At each layer all operand/mux-table reads precede scatter; every dropped placeholder must reach a real write before any read, including cycle wrap and observations

validation_scope: Independent RV64I oracle, byte-identical full retirement trace, live-data/memory fingerprints; not full-ISA or formal equivalence
maximum_scope: Highest validated median in the explicitly recorded single-thread CPU kernel/compiler/unroll/memory-layout search on this fixed tensor and program, not a proof of global maximum
excluded_observations: nu-native-prefix: accidental 1024-vs-512-cycle reference mismatch; no semantic failure or valid comparison
nu-full: correctness reference; initial timing briefly overlapped an own screening job
CPU117 early screenings: sibling later became busy; not pooled into final comparison
PGO training binaries and perf diagnostics are not ranked as benchmark candidates
Early SU/TI compilations were interrupted to partition generated code; final partitioned versions are separately validated
Naive memw-placeholder-check.json was superseded by exact cyclic liveness analysis in liveness.json

ranking_uncertainty.note: Observed sample ranges are not confidence intervals; a tiny median gap does not establish a unique stable optimum on a shared host.

historical_ru_comparison.note: Historical RU was measured on CPU95; not a same-round paired speedup
